topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Transferred, they call it. Like shuffling papers in a drawer, they moved me to this new slot. A different department, they say, new opportunities. More like a different cage, where the view changes but the bars stay. They speak of broadening horizons and learning curves. I suppose they expect me to smile and nod, to play along with this charade of growth and development. As if the real reason doesn't hover in the air, unspoken but thick as the walls that now confine me. A transfer is just a polite way of saying I'm surplus to requirements where I was, and now I'm someone else's problem.
